summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on October 13, 2026, furnishing a Hong Kong Exchange monthly return (equivalent to a routine US current report on Form 8-K, though not a material event) for the month ended September 30, 2026. The filing reports movements in securities: A-class WVR shares outstanding declined by 10,040,700 to 1,716,030,157, with a corresponding increase in treasury shares to 102,294,952, while B-class shares remained at 345,199,159. Public float compliance is confirmed. No special-situation transaction is involved; this is routine capital-structure housekeeping.
